messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":7,"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":7,"text":"He said, “Their freedom will be for seven days, that for seven days they may see the things you have been told, and afterwards they will be gathered together in their habitations.”","verse":101},{"chapter":7,"text":"I answered, “If I have found favor in your sight, show further to me your servant whether in the day of judgment the just will be able to intercede for the ungodly or to entreat the Most High for them,","verse":102},{"chapter":7,"text":"whether fathers for children, or children for parents, or kindred for kindred, or kinsfolk for their next of kin, or friends for those who are most dear.”","verse":103},{"chapter":7,"text":"He answered me, “Since you have found favor in my sight, I will show you this also. The day of judgment is a day of decision, and displays to all the seal of truth. Even as now a father doesn’t send his son, or a son his father, or a master his slave, or a friend him that is most dear, that in his place he may understand, or sleep, or eat, or be healed,","verse":104},{"chapter":7,"text":"so no one will ever pray for another in that day, neither will one lay a burden on another, for then everyone will each bear his own righteousness or unrighteousness.”","verse":105},{"chapter":7,"text":"I answered, “How do we now find that first Abraham prayed for the people of Sodom, and Moses for the ancestors who sinned in the wilderness,","verse":106},{"chapter":7,"text":"and Joshua after him for Israel in the days of Achan,","verse":107},{"chapter":7,"text":"and Samuel in the days of Saul, and David for the plague, and Solomon for those who would worship in the sanctuary,","verse":108},{"chapter":7,"text":"and Elijah for those that received rain, and for the dead, that he might live,","verse":109},{"chapter":7,"text":"and Hezekiah for the people in the days of Sennacherib, and many others prayed for many?","verse":110},{"chapter":7,"text":"If therefore now, when corruption has grown and unrighteousness increased, the righteous have prayed for the ungodly, why will it not be so then also?”","verse":111},{"chapter":7,"text":"He answered me, “This present world is not the end. The full glory doesn’t remain in it. Therefore those who were able prayed for the weak.","verse":112},{"chapter":7,"text":"But the day of judgment will be the end of this age, and the beginning of the immortality to come, in which corruption has passed away,","verse":113},{"chapter":7,"text":"intemperance is at an end, infidelity is cut off, but righteousness has grown, and truth has sprung up.","verse":114},{"chapter":7,"text":"Then no one will be able to have mercy on him who is condemned in judgment, nor to harm someone who is victorious.”","verse":115},{"chapter":7,"text":"I answered then, “This is my first and last saying, that it would have been better if the earth had not produced Adam, or else, when it had produced him, to have restrained him from sinning.","verse":116},{"chapter":7,"text":"For what profit is it for all who are in this present time to live in heaviness, and after death to look for punishment?","verse":117},{"chapter":7,"text":"O Adam, what have you done? For though it was you who sinned, the evil hasn’t fallen on you alone, but on all of us who come from you.","verse":118},{"chapter":7,"text":"For what profit is it to us, if an immortal time is promised to us, but we have done deeds that bring death?","verse":119},{"chapter":7,"text":"And that there is promised us an everlasting hope, but we have most miserably failed?","verse":120}]}
